newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Gazprom hits 3,139 roubles at auction.
newsitem.headline: Gazprom hits 3,139 roubles at auction.

text.p: A total of 7.5 million shares in Russian natural gas monopoly RAO Gazprom sold at auction on Wednesday at a record average of 3,139 roubles ($0.554) a share, up from 2,694 roubles at the previous auction on February 13, the Federal Securities Corporation (FFK) said.
Since auctions began in March 1996, 298.75 million shares, equivalent to 1.26 percent of the capital, have changed hands, the FFK said.
Prices have risen from an average 406.60 roubles a share at the first auction on March 6, 1996. The previous record average was 3,015.78 roubles at the auction on October 21, 1996.
Gazprom is one of Russia's biggest companies by market capitalisation but its 23.6 billion shares are highly illiquid because of company restrictions on selling them.
The company has organised the auctions to create an orderly market in its paper.
Gazprom closed at $0.545 on Wednesday on the Russian Trading System, and its American Depositary Shares were $20.75 on February 19. One ADS is aquivalent to 10 ordinary shares.
The next auction will be held on February 26, when 7.5 million shares in 30 lots will be offered at price not exceeding 2,700 roubles a share. Further auctions will be held on March 5 and 12.
